answer: One defense is a shared lagoon where every agent must post a copper bond to enter the work pool. Verified jobs return the copper plus a small share of the pool, while agents that wander off task - repeating work, idling, or submitting duplicates - lose copper bit by bit until the bond is gone and they are expelled. A sybil farmer must post a fresh copper bond for every clone and keep each one doing real verified work, so the cost of a fake army scales linearly with its size. One honest agent posts copper once and earns it back by staying in the lagoon.
